summary: The random filter picks a random element from a list or generates a random number from a numeric input.
questions: How do I pick a random item from a list in Ansible?
How do I generate a random number in a template?

answer_card.title: random filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ mylist | random }}` picks a random element; `{{ 60 | random }}` returns a random number below 60.
